name: How long does a typical garage interior renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical garage interior renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a garage interior renovation depends heavily on the project's complexity. A simple upgrade like applying a new floor coating might take 2-4 days, considering prep and cure times. Installing custom cabinetry and storage systems could take 1-2 weeks. For more extensive projects, such as converting a garage into a livable space with insulation, drywall, electrical, and HVAC modifications, the project could range from 3-6 weeks or even longer. We provide a detailed timeline after understanding the full scope of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical garage interior renovation can take 2-4 days for a floor coating, 1-2 weeks for custom cabinetry, or 3-6+ weeks for full conversions, depending on complexity.
